T2S-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating models' ability to extract structured representations from scientific text. It includes three curated components: T2S-Train-1.2k for training, T2S-Bench-MR (500 samples) for multi-hop reasoning, and T2S-Bench-E2E (87 samples) for end-to-end… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/T2SBench/T2S-Bench-E2E.
reputation: Moderately adopted by researchers focusing on extracting structured representations from scientific text; referenced in recent work on structure-of-thought style evaluations.
